material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bakes private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): remains are one-off set pieces
pivot: bbox centre in X/Y, lowest point at z = 0; in Blender +X is screen right and +Y screen up (north) for a yaw_from_sprite row
dresses: the merchant (blue) hacked down: the chest split to the ribs, the belly cut open with entrails out, a forearm struck off, in his blood
third_party: MakeHuman CC0 base mesh, skin, eyes and hair (Art/Characters/ThirdParty/MakeHuman), through the source character
known_weaknesses: The body is the rigged merchant of PhotorealPass/Unclaimed posed by rule (limbs aimed into the plane of the back and sunk to the ground, no cloth simulation: the clothes follow the skin weights), baked again onto one 2048 px atlas, so face, hands and hair are softer than on the living character and the hair is a hard cut-out. The openings are cut by a ragged ellipse and their inside is a displaced lump of muscle with plain rib rods and three loops of gut: no organs, no anatomy beyond that; severed ends are a lump and a rod of bone. Scaled by 1.00 to keep body and pool inside the 1.85 m footprint of the 1997 picture. The pool, the drops and the soaked fringe are a flat alpha-tested card 6 mm above the ground. Static.
derived_from: Unclaimed/npc_merchant_blue/Merchant (SK_Merchant_PR LOD0), posed dead, opened, bloodied and baked again
gore_in_mesh: opened body with flesh rims, ribs and entrails as the picture shows, severed parts with stumps, blood round the wounds; pool card with drops and a soaked fringe (no companion decal)
